title: 实木家具材质与工艺术语

intro.background: 幼儿园家具最核心的卖点是实木、环保、安全。常用木材包括松木、橡胶木、桦木、碳化木。表面处理有PU漆、UV漆、木蜡油三种。
intro.desc: 掌握教玩具常用木材、表面处理、安全工艺的英语表达。
outcomes: 能用英语介绍家具材质
能回答客户环保等级问题

oneLiner.en: When a buyer asks what wood is it, answer with species, grade, finish and certification.
oneLiner.cn: 客户问什么木时，你必须回答树种、等级、表面处理和认证。

vocab.ex: We use rubberwood for most tables.
vocab.exCn: 我们大部分桌子用橡胶木。

vocab.ex: Birch plywood has a smooth finish.
Wood wax oil shows natural grain.

mistakes.right: It is FSC-certified rubberwood, water-based PU, E0 grade.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说实木。要具体说树种认证。

basic.en: We use solid rubberwood for the frame.
The finish is water-based PU paint.
All edges are rounded for safety.
basic.cn: 所有边缘倒圆保证安全。

advanced.en: Our furniture is FSC-certified rubberwood with water-based PU finish, meeting EN71-3 and E0, certified by TUV Rheinland.
advanced.cn: 我们的家具FSC认证橡胶木，水性PU，符合EN71-3和E0，TUV莱茵认证。
advanced.from: We use solid rubberwood for the frame.

advanced.en: Every edge is routed to 3mm radius, hardware is child-proof and recessed per EN1176.
advanced.cn: 所有边缘倒3mm，五金儿童防误触嵌入式，符合EN1176。
advanced.from: All edges are rounded for safety.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: What wood is this chair made of?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: It is solid rubberwood, FSC certified, water-based PU paint, E0 grade, non-toxic for children.
lines.cn: 实木橡胶木，FSC认证，水性PU漆，E0级，儿童无毒。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: For outdoor, we recommend thermowood, heat-treated to resist rot, with 5-year warranty.
lines.cn: 户外推荐碳化木，热处理防腐，5年质保。

scenario.q: A German client asks about wood and finish. Reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: Our tables are FSC-certified rubberwood with water-based PU finish. Panels meet E0 standards, edges rounded to 3mm, paint certified to EN71-3. We can provide TUV reports.
scenario.cn: 我们的桌子FSC认证橡胶木，水性PU，板材E0，边缘倒3mm，涂料EN71-3认证，可提供TUV报告。

checklist: 我能描述圆角安全工艺

culture.title: 欧洲客户为什么死磕环保
culture.content: 欧洲客户对儿童家具环保要求近乎苛刻。报价时主动写FSC木材+E0板材+水性漆+EN71-3报告，这是和便宜小厂的差异化。

aiPractice.situation: 英国客户Emma询问材质和环保。

rounds.ai: What wood do you use? Is it safe?

rounds.hint: 推荐碳化木，耐候，5年质保。
